calculation.description: Fade each asset's 20-day cumulative return after removing the contemporaneous cross-asset median 20-day move, scaling by the 20-day standard deviation of returns relative to the daily cross-sectional median. Larger values indicate relatively weak residual performers with a stronger expected rebound. All inputs are lagged completed observations.

validation.regime_notes: 10-day IC remained positive in 2024-2027 (0.058278, 365 dates), 2028-2031 (0.054023, 1043 dates), and 2032-2035 (0.033158, 797 dates). 2020-2023 had no eligible forward observations in the evaluated truncated sample. Small 15-asset cross-section implies conservative uncertainty interpretation.
